text: State budget records surplus of VNĐ330.9 trillion in 10 months

HÀ NỘI - State budget revenue in the first 10 months of 2026 reached nearly VNĐ2.44 quadrillion (US$93.8 billion), while State budget expenditure was VNĐ2.1 quadrillion, helping the State budget record a surplus of nearly VNĐ331 trillion.

According to a report from the National Statistics Office, total State budget revenue in the first 10 months increased by 11 per cent compared to the same period last year, and was equivalent to 96.4 per cent of the annual estimate.
Of the total, domestic revenue made up VNĐ2.1 quadrillion, reaching 95.6 per cent of the annual estimate and representing an 11.4 per cent increase compared to the same period last year.
Revenue from crude oil contributed VNĐ56.3 trillion, reaching 131.0 per cent of the annual estimate and representing a 38.3 per cent increase compared to the same period last year.
Meanwhile, revenue from import and export activities reached VNĐ275.8 trillion, reaching 99.2 per cent of the annual estimate and representing a 3.6 per cent increase on year.
Total State budget expenditure was VNĐ2.1 quadrillion, equivalent to 66.8 per cent of the annual estimate and an increase of 14.8 per cent compared to 2025.
Of this total, regular expenditures reached VNĐ1.28 quadrillion, representing 70.8 per cent of the annual estimate, and marking a 2.2 per cent rise on-year.
Development investment expenditure was nearly VNĐ735 trillion, up 49.7 per cent, while interest payments on debts totalled VNĐ90.2 trillion, up 4.5 per cent. - BIZHUB/VNS
